summary: This bill expands the advanced manufacturing production tax credit to include "black mass," which is an intermediate material recovered from recycled lithium-ion batteries, for components produced and sold in tax years beginning after December 31, 2024.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands an existing tax credit, which effectively reduces government revenue and can be considered a form of indirect government spending or subsidy. The expansion to include 'black mass' will increase the scope of this spending.

The bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to expand an advanced manufacturing production credit, which will result in lower tax liabilities for eligible manufacturers. This directly reduces the tax burden for specific industries.
